create_DCFRSolver: create a Discounted CFR solver for an imperfect-information game with configurable alpha, beta, gamma parameters
create_LCFRSolver: create a Linear CFR solver for an imperfect-information game with linear averaging and equal discount factors
run_DCFR_iteration: run a single discounted CFR iteration that evaluates and updates counterfactual regrets and average strategies
compute_counterfactual_regret: compute counterfactual regret for a player across all info states in a game tree
initialize_info_state_nodes: initialize info state nodes for all players with legal actions and current player tracking
